articles.description: LSE- and A2X Markets-listed Neo Energy Metals has appointed Elmarié Maritz CFO, taking over from Martin Westerman who served as acting CFO from June and moves to the newly created role of group head of operations and project delivery. articles.title: Eramet restarts nickel mine in Indonesia
articles.description: French group Eramet is restarting operations at the Weda Bay nickel mine in Indonesia after suspending output earlier this year when it used up a reduced mining quota. Indonesia, the world's biggest nickel producer, cut mining volume permits this year as part of steps to exert greater control over commodity exports and prices.
